entities.name: Consolidate hexadecimal encoding on Effect
entities.summary: Delete twelve hand-written byte-to-lowercase-hex implementations in favor of the pinned Effect Encoding function while preserving every digest input, identity, prefix, and typed failure.

acceptance: All 256 one-byte values and fixed empty and multi-byte vectors match an independent legacy oracle
Exactly twelve scoped production encoders use pinned Effect Encoding directly
Digest inputs, domain prefixes, public identities, and typed hash failures remain unchanged
Focused normalized-core, build, project, reference, tracer, and bytecode observations remain exact
No Control Room source is changed

relations.summary: The bounded reuse migration removes generic encoding machinery across identity-bearing project tooling without changing its semantic contracts.
